description: UIVW column with valueexpression (CONCAT for inline HTML link). Demonstrates textmode:'true' + no valuefield + displayname for header. Empirically verified against surveyed TASK view patterns.
notes: textmode: 'true' is MANDATORY when valueexpression is set — Workfront uses this to know the column is calc-driven
Field references inside the expression use {fieldname} syntax — defer the calc-language syntax to workfront-textmode

For iterate-mode (one-row-per-child-record) add: type:'iterate', listmethod:'nested().lists', listdelimiter:'
'
Cross-tenant clone: if the valueexpression contains a hardcoded https://<host>... URL, the sanitizer flags it for host_rewrite (see 05-gotchas.md #11)
